name: View Volume Transformation Based Layered Method
aliases: Layered rendering method for CGH with view volume transformation
definition: A layered rendering method for generating computer-generated holograms (CGH) of 3D objects that uses view volume transformation to avoid shape distortion and size deviation in the reconstructed image, preserving the real size of the original model.
summary: A layered rendering method for computer-generated holograms that uses view volume transformation to preserve the real size of 3D objects, avoiding the shape distortion and size deviation common in conventional techniques.
